invariants.rationale: The method uses stream and collect, producing a non-null list.
Each small file must have a non-null file ID since location.getFileId() should not return null for valid SmallFile objects.
The output list has the same number of elements as the smallFiles list due to the 1:1 mapping.
The list of file IDs may contain duplicates, but the number of unique IDs can never exceed the list size.
File IDs are typically non-empty strings; defensively, this ensures output integrity.
